description:
Capture gate evidence for evaluation and for prechecks through one function that also enforces the prompt size limit and resolves the evaluated issue, gate registry and gate definition once per captured image, and delete the precheck variant.

## Background

- Precheck: `captured_precheck_plan` (`crates/jit/src/commands/mod.rs:659-755`) builds `PrecheckEvidence` (`mod.rs:568-607`) and prompts. It records `VirtualPath::GATES` instead of the gate definitions, reads no issue document or pinned evidence (by `@/issue/8454236c/decision/D-1`; `PrecheckEvidence::matches` compares only paths the image's capture spec holds), parses run records itself (`mod.rs:699-716`), and reads prompt files without a size check (`mod.rs:729-734`). Callers: `publish_captured_lifecycle_mutation` (`mod.rs:2827,2928`) and the test helper `capture_precheck_plan` (`mod.rs:3646-3671`).
- Evaluation: `captured_gate_evaluation` (`crates/jit/src/commands/gate_check.rs:321-425`) builds `GateEvaluationEvidence` (`gate_check.rs:80-91`) with the gate definition, document paths and pinned evidence for exec checkers, run inputs from `captured_gate_runs`, and checks `MAX_PROMPT_FILE_SIZE` (`gate_check.rs:15,385-392`). Callers: `check_gate_with` (`gate_check.rs:949,1005`) and a unit test (`:2624`).
- `build_captured_gate_context` checks the size limit a second time (`gate_check.rs:1273-1280`); for prechecks it is the only check, so an oversized precheck prompt fails only when that gate's context is built, after earlier prechecks have run (`execute_captured_prechecks`, `gate_check.rs:1442`).
- Run history and verdict reuse are read from the captured image: a gate capture holds only the evaluated issue's latest runs, and reuse reads one verdict record.
- `capture_gate_evaluation_image` (`gate_check.rs:762-886`) resolves the bound issue, the registry and the gate (`captured_bound_issue`, `captured_gate_registry`, `required_automated_gate` at `:818-820`) to decide the capture, then returns only `(image, target_id)`.
- `check_gate_with` (`gate_check.rs:902`) resolves all three again from the same image in its inputs attempt (`:930-932`) and looks the gate up a third time in the registry (`:955-958`). Its record session calls `capture_gate_evaluation_image` again and repeats the resolution on that image (`:984-995`).
- Two more functions parsed one image's declarations twice (`captured_issue_rule_report` `:461-462`, `captured_scope_rule_report` `:523-524`); the built-in checkers now select from the one validation report, which removed both.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: One function captures gate evidence for one issue and a set of gates (definitions, input identities, run history, pinned evidence where the capture spec holds it, the validation view and prompts); `captured_precheck_plan`'s evidence capture and `captured_gate_evaluation` are replaced by it, and one evidence type replaces `PrecheckEvidence` and `GateEvaluationEvidence`.
- [hard] REQ-02: `MAX_PROMPT_FILE_SIZE` is checked only in that function; `build_captured_gate_context` performs no size check.
- [hard] REQ-03: Precheck evidence still holds no issue document or pinned evidence its mutation base did not capture, and `test_precheck_evidence_detects_prompt_mutation_and_preserves_captured_bytes` (`mod.rs:4356`) passes.
- [hard] REQ-04: A harness test with two auto prechecks, the first of whose checker creates a marker file and the second of whose prompt file exceeds the limit, shows the transition refused with the size-limit error and no marker file created; today the marker exists because the first precheck runs before the second fails.
- [hard] REQ-05: `capture_gate_evaluation_image` returns the captured image together with the bound issue, the parsed gate registry and the gate definition it resolved, `check_gate_with`'s inputs attempt resolves none of them again, and the record session resolves the issue, registry and gate of its own image once, through the same return value, and compares them with the evaluated ones.
- [hard] REQ-06: No function in `gate_check.rs` parses one captured image's declarations or gate registry more than once, and the gate check suites pass unchanged.

## Notes

- Behaviour change: an oversized precheck prompt now refuses the transition at capture, before any precheck runs, instead of when its own context is built. The error text is unchanged.
- The resolve-once change leaves behaviour unchanged.
- `bulk-apply-one-session`, which this task follows, adds a bulk precheck preflight through the shared state derivation; that preflight reaches the evidence capture through `captured_precheck_plan`, so it moves onto the one evidence type here with the lifecycle path.
- Written against the code as it stands after the changes this one follows; line citations name current code.
title: One gate evidence capture resolves its inputs once and enforces the prompt limit
